People's Majlis Environment and Climate Change Committee
Agenda

Committee: People's Majlis Environment and Climate Change Committee
Meeting: 13th meeting
Venue: Committee Room 7
Date: 21 October 2026 (Wednesday)
Time: 11:00

• Reviewing the work pending before the committee.
- Resolution submitted to determine the views of the Members of the People's Majlis on the high cost that small and medium businesses operating in regions other than Malé have to bear for electricity and water services (deadline expired on 4 November 2025).

- Assessment prepared regarding permitting beverage bottles packaged in plastic smaller than 500 ml in the Maldives.

- Letter sent by Project Thimaveshi [unclear] and other associations sharing concerns about the losses that would result from reducing the protected area of Eedhigali Kilhi and Koattey for the work of a project planned to widen the link road in Addu City Hithadhoo.

- Letter sent sharing concerns regarding the land reclamation work in the Moolekede Fishimathi area of Addu.
